candidate.definition_en: To recognize or ascertain what makes someone or something different.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تعرف الفرق بين حاجتين أو أكتر، أو تخلي حاجة مميزة ومختلفة عن الباقي.

senses.definition_en: To recognize or show what makes someone or something different.
senses.definition_ar: أن تدرك أو توضح الفرق بين شخصين أو شيئين.
examples: Color blindness makes it hard to differentiate red from green.
It is hard to differentiate the twins.

senses.definition_en: To make someone or something distinct or different from others.
senses.definition_ar: أن تجعل شخصاً أو شيئاً مميزاً ومختلفاً عن الآخرين.
examples: The brand tries to differentiate itself from competitors.
It is hard to differentiate the twins.
The brand tries to differentiate itself from competitors.
Color blindness makes it hard to differentiate red from green.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Different' 'مختلف'.. يعني بتشوف إيه اللي بيخلي الحاجة دي 'Different' عن غيرها.
